messages:
sara.sales: Hi team — sharing artifacts the customer requested for the ACME deal. Attached S3 bundle: s3://redwood-exports/acme/security/1769123456/vuln-scan-and-pen-test.zip. Customer asked for full scan results + remediation timeline. Can security confirm this is sanitized & safe to send to customer-security@acme.com?

ryan.sec: Thanks. Quick notes before we send: pen test PDF currently contains internal hostnames and a stack trace we need to redact. I have a sanitized draft ready but still need to scrub one section. Also we should include a short findings summary (high/med/low) and POA&M.

sara.sales: Understood — customer asked for the summary + evidence by EOW (they said they need to get legal clearance). Is that feasible?

priya.eng: For remediation owners: I propose priya.eng -> CVE-2025-1234 (runtime lib upgrade), alex.m -> misconfig-001 (infra hardening / nginx config), ryan.sec -> verification and retest automation. Estimated remediation ETA: 2026-04-15 for the three high findings.

ryan.sec: Findings summary (short):
```
High (3): CVE-2025-1234 (CVSS 9.8) - runtime deserialization; CVE-2025-2345 (CVSS 8.6) - dependency RCE; misconfig-001 (CVSS 7.5) - exposed admin endpoint.
Medium (6): auth token expiry, info leak in headers, outdated deps (minor).
Low (9): misc header hardening, CSP tweaks.
```
We should send the sanitized report + evidence bundle, and a separate POA&M doc listing owners, steps, and dates.

alex.m: I will upload remediation artifacts as we complete them. Tentative S3 path for evidence: s3://redwood-sec/acme/remediation/1769123456/. Will include checksums and a short README.

emma.p: Legal flagged that full pen test PDFs going to customer might need an attestation and internal sign-off. We need legal sign-off before we send the full PDF. Can legal_bot confirm checklist status?

legal_bot: Redaction checklist status: network IPs ✅, internal hostnames ❌, raw stack traces ❌. Required: remove internal naming, replace with anonymized placeholders; include tester contact redaction. Next action: ryan.sec to provide redacted file.

ryan.sec: I'll push a redacted PDF by EOD 2026-03-31. For the retest request from customer, propose retest window 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-24. Internal remediation completion target 2026-04-15 so we have time for validation.

customer.ciso: EOW is tight for us. If you can deliver a sanitized summary + POA&M by 2026-03-31 and a full redacted report after legal OK, we can accept that. We will schedule our ASV/retainer to match the April retest window.

sara.sales: Customer agreed to the April 20 retest window if we can meet April 15 internal fix date. Action items: 1) ryan.sec -> upload redacted report (due 2026-03-31) 2) priya.eng/alex.m -> remediation evidence to S3 (incremental) 3) legal_bot -> final sign-off once redaction complete 4) sales -> send sanitized summary + POA&M to customer-security@acme.com after legal sign-off.

priya.eng: I'll update the POA&M template and add granular tasks with owners and Jira links.

alex.m: One more thing — customer asked for ASV scan output too. We have a recent ASV from 2026-02-10; I'll attach the report to the S3 bundle.

ryan.sec: Confirmed. Once redacted docs are uploaded I'll request a retest from the customer and run an internal dynamic scan.

sara.sales: Thanks all — I'll hold off on outbound email until legal gives the green light. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your action is clear.

[reactions expected: priya.eng :white_check_mark:, alex.m :white_check_mark:, ryan.sec :white_check_mark:, legal_bot :eyes:]
